answer: The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. The price of trying is a 17-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, paid up front for every single name, while the mirror stays small. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Sootbound gall sealer black warrant sees to it, since a warrant gall sealers show after ink room trials. The whisper is checked, not assumed. One sable, one entry.
